title: How Deleting the Screenshot Kills the Sin You Keep Calling Venting
caption:
That screenshot in your camera roll isn't proof. It's a grudge you've been feeding on repeat.

Venting doesn't heal a wound. It just finds it a bigger audience. Scripture calls you to confess it to one man, not broadcast it to twelve.

Delete the screenshot before you defend keeping it.

#faith #confession #selfcontrol #christianmen #brotherhood #manofgod
